title: Make Leitstand Git health worktree-aware
goal: Make Leitstand runtime-health Git identity resolution support both normal checkouts and linked Git worktrees without weakening fail-closed health semantics.

acceptance.assertion: Runtime health resolves Git HEAD and ref data when .git is either a directory or a linked-worktree gitdir file.
Existing normal-checkout health behavior and fail-closed error reporting remain unchanged.
An automated test creates or simulates a linked worktree and proves the health receipt reports the expected commit instead of a false failure.
The fix changes only Git identity discovery and does not add execution authority, network dependencies or mutable health state.

metadata.evidence: Leitstand consumer PR local full suite passed 340 of 341 tests; tests/serverHealth.test.ts failed reproducibly only in a linked worktree because runtimeHealth Git discovery assumed a .git directory. GitHub CI in a normal checkout was green.
does_not_establish: production runtime deployment by this closeout
absence of unrelated artifact-test isolation defects
metadata.outcome: Leitstand PR #167 had already implemented the complete linked-worktree Git health contract on 2026-07-14. Fresh readback on current remote main 362dda6ac161bf275a38682d18998fc284eebe52 confirmed the merge commit is an ancestor, and the focused runtime-health suite passed all 10 tests. The stale planned task is therefore terminalized without another Leitstand code change.

evidence.result: resolveCommonGitDir, safe loose/common ref lookup, packed-refs fallback, and two linked-worktree regression tests added

gitdir-resolution.evidence: resolveGitDir handles a normal .git directory and a gitdir: file; readGitRef resolves worktree-local, common-dir and packed refs.

normal-checkout-regression.evidence: The focused runtime-health suite passed 10/10 on current main and retains the normal-checkout assertions and fail-closed warning behavior.

linked-worktree-test.evidence: Two automated tests simulate linked worktrees with loose and packed branch refs and assert the expected commit and branch.

scope-boundary.evidence: PR #167 changed Git identity discovery and tests without adding network calls, execution authority or mutable health state.

validation: GitHub PR #167 state MERGED; merge commit e74b2a4e981a374a9eb48ddb9983299199535d15; required checks green at merge.
pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtimeHealth.test.ts -> 10 passed, 0 failed.

Full pnpm test was also sampled: runtimeHealth remained green, while 8 unrelated controller tests failed because live artifacts leaked into test defaults; this does not weaken T022 evidence and is recorded separately.
